description: Compares surreal sketch, anti-comedy, cringe, and reality-based television as ways of unsettling the audience’s expectations about a punch line or ending. Uses Nathan for You and constructed documentary examples to examine editing, apparent authenticity, consent, and the ethical limits of experimental satire.
